entry.summary:
With no intention of chasing fame, @Te-Wehi has experienced a remarkable year. From chart‑topping songs and sold‑out shows to returning home to a humble farm life in Edgecumbe, his journey has been anything but ordinary. In this video, Charlotte Ryan sits down with Te Wehi to get to know the person behind the music.
